name: boundary-circle-bounce-repulsion-one-step
note: One step on the circular domain (radius 0.5 * boundary scale 1.03), bounce mode. Particle 0 starts outside the wall with outward + tangential velocity so restitution and damping both change the bounce. Particle 1 sits in the soft repulsion zone with zero velocity so only repulsion runs. Gravity and collision are off; turbulence pull and affect-position are off; velocity damping is 1.
